column1:
Digitizing water data 
We will use our technology to 
generate actionable insights, increase 
awareness of water issues, and 
optimize water replenishment.

Becoming water positive 
by 2030
We will reduce the water intensity of 
our direct operations, replenish in 
water-stressed regions where we work, 
and enable access to 1.5 million people.
column3:
Influencing policy 
We will use our voice at the local, 
national, and global levels to increase 
water access and availability, improve 
quality, and ensure the integration of 
water into climate strategies.

column2:
Empowering our customers 
and partners 
We are developing solutions to help 
customers and partners understand 
water-related risks.
